answer.rationale: With the line at 94% of committed volume and no buffer, an unqualified primary-vendor switch 14 days before expiry creates unacceptable interruption exposure. A guarded second-source qualification directly addresses the single-point-of-failure risk evidenced in memory_c3 while preserving incumbent continuity during the transition. This does not by itself assure the mandated 18% spend reduction, so the cost outcome and the alternate supplier's qualification, capacity, and delivered-cost economics remain explicit uncertainties requiring verification before any broader change.
